These are original, offline test books, generated by `make_fixtures.py` using
only Python's standard library. All fixture prose and generated bytes are
dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0. They contain no acquired book,
device identifier, encryption key or third-party binary.

- `paper-boat.mobi`: UTF-8 MOBI7, uncompressed PalmDB text records.
- `paper-boat.prc`: the same original text with PalmDOC literal-run compression.
- `paper-boat.azw3`: KF8 (MOBI header version 8), with a real FDST record
  separating XHTML from a CSS flow. This tests KF8 reconstruction rather than
  renaming a MOBI7 book. It is a simple single-part KF8 book; complex fragment
  and skeleton indices are handled by the system libmobi implementation.

The original story is long enough to produce two Reader text pages, allowing
TOC and resume tests. Their titles are `晨光中的纸船 · MOBI7` and
`晨光中的纸船 · KF8`. The opening sentence is
`清晨，小舟载着一片树叶，慢慢经过石桥。`; the final sentence is
`傍晚，我们在岸边把故事读完。`.

Format-field references are the upstream libmobi 0.12 `mobi.h`, `read.c` and
`util.c`: https://github.com/bfabiszewski/libmobi/tree/v0.12/src . No upstream
source is vendored or executed by this generator.

Regenerate from the repository root:

```sh
python3 apps/reader/tests/fixtures/kindle/make_fixtures.py
PYTHONPATH=apps/reader/src python3 -m unittest discover -s apps/reader/tests -p test_kindle.py -v
```

Real-conversion tests use `/usr/bin/mobitool` from `libmobi-tools`. For a local
development build only, tests accept `TYPIX_TEST_MOBITOOL=/absolute/mobitool`;
the shipped Reader always uses the fixed system path.
